description:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of the contexts a field is used in. Deprecated, use [ Get custom field contexts](#api-rest-api-3-field-fieldId-context-get).

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The ID of the field to return contexts for.
parameters.name: fieldId

parameters.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).
parameters.name: startAt

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: maxResults

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have the necessary permission.
